window-1.title: ssh.place — Timelapses
window-1.blurb: Watch a whole day of strangers quietly fighting and collaborating over one 200×60 pixel canvas replay as a GIF — it's a tiny communal folk-art archive made entirely in a terminal, and I think you'll want to go claim a corner of it.

window-2.title: Colossal
window-2.blurb: It's a daily drip of people who went way too far on a handmade idea — thread portraits, stop-motion obsessives, clay worlds — and you'll come away with three new side quests before lunch.

window-3.title: Carrot Shrub (Nonalcoholic)
window-3.blurb: It's a vinegar-bright, sesame-peppery, glowing-orange drink that starts with you pickling your own baby carrots — a side quest in a glass, and the exact shade of orange that photographs like a dream on film.

window-4.title: Freunde von Freunden — Home Visits
window-4.blurb: It's the nosy-friend archive of creatives' actual apartments — unstyled shelves, thrifted lamps, projects mid-sprawl — and it'll convince you that a room full of your own side-quest evidence beats any showroom.

window-5.title: Toriei, Cuppage Plaza
window-5.blurb: A brand-new ten-seat yakitori counter buried on the fourth floor of Cuppage Plaza's gloriously time-warped 80s maze — the kind of place you have to hunt for, then smugly tell everyone about.
